app.name: Quoba
app.tagline: Everything you said, in one place.

sources.emptySidebar: Connect your chats, mail and files
sources.intro: Choose where Quoba looks. Everything is read and indexed on this computer.
sources.probeFailed: Couldn't check your sources. Press “Check again” to retry.
sources.privacy: Chats, mail and files never leave this computer. Only when you ask for an AI answer are the few relevant excerpts sent to the AI model.
sources.installHelp: Quoba reads {{tool}}'s local archive. Install {{tool}}, sign in with it once, then press Check again.

about.discord: Servers and DMs from the Discord app
about.files: Documents, PDFs, slides and HWP in chosen folders

github.tokenPlaceholder: Access token (kept in your system keychain)

mail.accountPlaceholder: Account name set up in mailcrawl

search.label: Search everything you said
search.placeholder: Search what was said… e.g. who said they'd make the slides
suggestions: What did I promise to do this week?
Who said they'd book the venue?
search.noSources: Connect a chat app, your mail or a folder to start searching.
search.failed: Search didn't work. Check Sources and try again.
search.noResults: Nothing found. Try other words or widen the filters.
search.partial: Some sources were busy and skipped. Results may be incomplete.

answer.label: Answer
answer.signInTitle: Get an AI answer with sources
answer.signInBody: Sign in once in your browser. No API key needed.

errors.signed-out: Sign in to get AI answers.
errors.model-unavailable: The AI model isn't available right now. Your search results are below.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the AI service. Check your connection.
errors.unknown: Couldn't write an answer this time. Your search results are below.

context.label: Context
context.empty: Select a result to see it here.

promises.intro: Things you said you'd do, collected from your own messages. Tick them off as you go.
promises.needNames: Add the names you use in chats so Quoba knows which messages are yours.
promises.failed: Couldn't collect promises. Check Sources and try again.

timeline.intro: Pick a topic to see who said what about it, in order.
timeline.label: Topic
timeline.empty: Nothing dated found for this topic.

general.languageHelp: Menus, labels and dates. Messages stay in their original language.
general.followSystemHelp: Switch automatically when your computer's language changes.
general.launchAtLoginHelp: Keeps new messages indexed in the background.
general.namesHelp: Add every name you appear as (nickname, real name, English name). Quoba uses them for “Said by me” and Promises.
general.namesPlaceholder: Type a name and press Enter

account.signedInHelp: AutoRAG's hosted models write your answers. No API key needed.
account.signedOutHelp: Search works without signing in. Sign in for AI answers.
account.cliHelp: Signing in here also signs in the autorag command line, and the other way around.

shortcuts.globalHelp: Works even when Quoba is in the background.
shortcuts.help: Click a shortcut and press new keys. Backspace clears it.

privacy.local: Your chats, mail and files are read and indexed on this computer. Quoba has no server and never uploads them.
privacy.ai: When you get an AI answer, the few excerpts relevant to your question are sent to the AI model to write it. Search results alone never leave your computer.
privacy.tokens: Access tokens are encrypted with your system keychain.

welcome.title: Everything you said, in one place
welcome.body: Quoba searches your chats, mail, notes and files at once, and shows exactly where something was said.

names.title: What do people call you?
names.body: Add the names you appear as in chats. Quoba uses them to find what you said and what you promised.

sources.title: Connect your places
sources.body: Turn on what you want to search. You can change this any time in Sources.

ai.title: Get answers, not just results
ai.body: Sign in once in your browser to get AI answers with sources and automatic promises. No API key needed. You can skip this; search works without it.
